steps: Confirm your Nurse license is active and in good standing in California.
Submit a license verification request from California through the appropriate national registry or the state board directly.
File an application for licensure by endorsement with Florida's licensing board.
Pay the Florida application fee (approx. $285) and submit supporting documents.
Await processing — typically 14-45 days in Florida.
notes: Florida's nurse licensing requirements are administered per the state's licensing authority. Florida trade licenses are issued by the Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR); healthcare licenses go through the Department of Health. Always confirm current rules directly with the official board before applying, since requirements change.
